title: PR body content-quality enforcement registry
description: Shape-only schema for .gitapex/pr-body-quality.enforcement.toml. The defect-class key set and its enforced/backing referential integrity are owned by scripts/scan_pr_body_quality_drift.py (the normative validator); the key set is intentionally not duplicated here as an enum so a new defect class needs no schema edit, only the drift gate's own KNOWN_DEFECTS update. Refs #1828, #2342.
